design_philosophy: Premium global QA automation consultancy. Enterprise SaaS-style aesthetics. Clean, professional, futuristic but grounded. Light theme with generous whitespace, crisp typography, and emerald green accents to signify 'passing tests' and 'growth'. No generic templates, no crowded UIs.

navbar.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-emerald-100/50 shadow-sm

cards.standard: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-medium transition-all shadow-md hover:shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-200 px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-medium transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.outline: bg-transparent text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 hover:border-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-700 px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-medium transition-all

hero.layout: grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[90vh] relative overflow-hidden
hero.visual: Use 'hero_dashboard_visual' floating with framer-motion animation on the right side. Optionally use 'architecture_background' as an absolute positioned subtle opacity layer behind the hero text.

services.layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
services.style: Bento grid inspired layout. Some cards span 2 columns to break monotony.

architecture.style: Horizontal connected flow or a 2x2 precise grid with structural borders. Minimalist.

frameworks.layout: Grid or infinite scrolling marquee using 'react-fast-marquee'
frameworks.style: Tech-focused, use monospace font for framework names to look like code.

industries.card_style: Image background with dark overlay bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-black/20, text white at the bottom.

portfolio.style: Large cards with metric highlights (e.g., '99% Faster Release', '0% Production Bugs').

contact.form_style: Clean inputs with focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500. Buttons for WhatsApp/LinkedIn.

footer.accent: Emerald accents for links. Large brand typography.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion initial={{opacity:0, y:20}} whileInView={{opacity:1, y:0}} viewport={{once:true}} transition={{duration:0.5}}
motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis library recommended for momentum scrolling.

images.description: 3D Isometric Dashboard visualization for the hero section.
Abstract architecture background for hero or architecture section.
Modern office building with blue facade.

testing.required_attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

dependencies.instructions: Install framer-motion, lucide-react, @phosphor-icons/react, and shadcn/ui primitives. Setup Tailwind CSS with custom colors.
